governance.authorized_delivery: Accepted amended G1 cohort authorizes permanent meaningful sharded standard GitHub Actions and Chaos Scheduler App delivery for this target. This supersedes inherited runnerless-only hosting restrictions for this CI transition. The retired PR controller will not resume.
governance.review_authority: The authoring agent automatically captures a fresh enrolled independent review under the originating PR-creation account before every ready PR and after any head, current base or trusted policy change. Use a qualified same-account cloud route when available, otherwise the qualified trusted local adapter. No human technical review or cross-account substitution.
governance.bootstrap_limits: PR104 admitted source implementation with the producer registry intentionally disabled/empty. This final bootstrap admits the actual runtime-verified WORK-origin producer with current repository-specific adapter/instruction hashes. Source enrollment does not activate the App: REVIEWER_APP_ENABLED stays OFF until current merged-main CI, exact installation/scope/non-bypass controls and read-only trusted-main App qualification pass. This closes initial source/producer admission; subsequent ordinary changes use automatic originating-account review and qualified App-only delivery, with no human technical reviewer or blanket CI refresh gate.
governance.native_delivery_authority: The qualified Chaos Scheduler App4217367 is the only authorized automatic approver and native delivery actor. It supplies or reconciles its own exact-head approval and requests native SQUASH immediately when merge-ready or native SQUASH auto-merge when eligible blocked, after fresh originating-account independent review, exact-tuple meaningful CI and strict protections. Other approvals never substitute for the App evidence; coexisting unsolicited approvals are not inherently prohibited. Agents cannot merge, pre-arm, cancel auto-merge or bypass checks. No failed/ambiguous mutation permits blind retry or fallback.
governance.source_limits: CI and delivery transition only. Real relationships, registry, lockkit, downstream state, frozen plans and held work are preserved. No source or local receipt proves publication, hosted execution, admission, installation, activation or delivery.
governance.concurrent_writer_boundary: On 2026-11-17 the operator explicitly accepted the documented GitHub concurrent-writer race and directed execution to proceed. App-only delivery is an authorization and operating rule, not atomic exclusion of all other write-capable actors. Another actor may arm auto-merge between the final null read and App approval, and that approval may release its request. Unknown or observed existing auto-merge still fails admission. Existing-review reconciliation does not eliminate the first-approval race. This acceptance is distinct from Q16 review-receipt operational trust and weakens no review/CI/identity gate or actor prohibition.
governance.administrative_visibility: The owner qualifies the complete bypass-actor policy with owner-visible reads during cutover; omitted full lists remain unknown, never assumed empty. Runtime uses the actual validated App writer token for GET-only effective-main/contributing-ruleset reads before approval and before native delivery, requiring complete active contributing coverage, current_user_can_bypass exactly never on every contributor, and unchanged App control evidence. CI_READ_TOKEN does not prove App-specific status. Trusted-main read-only qualification exercises the same check with its scoped App credential; each write independently rechecks its actual writer credential. These reads neither reveal other hidden actors nor atomically exclude later administrative drift. Existing visible actor checks, owner qualification, permission scopes and credential cleanup remain required.
governance.approval_reconciliation: Approval reconciliation uses currently visible GitHub records after fresh complete admission. A visible single current App approval is reused; visible duplicates or unknown/conflicting matching state stop. A later fully revalidated approval submission when no record is observed is not a blind fallback within a failed invocation. Delayed list visibility can leave a redundant authorized exact-head App approval audit record; no strong API consistency, at-most-once or exactly-once submission guarantee is claimed. No durable attempt store or new write endpoint is introduced; fresh independent review, exact CI, App identity and native-operation checks remain mandatory.

service_api_observations.rules_read_permissions: Current official GitHub REST documentation requires Metadata repository read permission for GET rules/branches, list rulesets and get ruleset. No Administration grant is needed. https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules
service_api_observations.native_head_precondition: Fresh read-only live GitHub GraphQL introspection of EnablePullRequestAutoMergeInput explicitly includes expectedHeadOid:GitObjectID; MergePullRequestInput also supports it. Keep the supported head precondition.
service_api_observations.ci_attempt_chronology: GitHub official OpenAPI workflow-run.run_started_at is the latest run start and resets on rerun. Select its unique latest completed attempt across run IDs; pending/running, missing/invalid timing or ambiguous latest starts refuse. This repairs a reproduced selector freshness gap; native required-check enforcement remains authoritative, and no native-merge bypass is claimed. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/rest-api-description/main/descriptions/api.github.com/api.github.com.json

ci_assurance_boundary.accepted_authority: Q07 permits automatic independent review and App delivery of sensitive CI/governance changes; Q11 requires the same originating account; Q16 accepts operational local review-receipt provenance. No human technical reviewer or blanket immutable CI-definition refresh gate is introduced.
ci_assurance_boundary.app_evidence: The trusted-main App authenticates current Actions identity/path, exact repository/revision/base/head, latest run/attempt, successful required jobs, native producer/check suite and bound aggregate output. The candidate contract digest binds inputs; it is not independent attestation that candidate code executed the full test set.
ci_assurance_boundary.mandatory_content_review: Fresh independent content review must examine candidate workflow, dispatcher, inventory, test assertions and failure propagation. All12 substantive original shell fixture suites and every assigned Python case must still execute in actual hosted CI. No-op jobs, omitted suites, fabricated measurements, weakened failures or tests stripped of meaningful assertions are review failures. Candidate CI code is untrusted review subject, never a replacement for trusted review/App code.
ci_assurance_boundary.limits: Reviewer false negatives and privileged forgery remain possible under accepted operational trust. No full admission bypass with conforming independent content review intact was established by the isolated CI-validator demonstration. Q16 does not authorize empty CI. Stale, failed, missing or skipped observed evidence remains blocked. A guarantee independent of both candidate implementation and content reviewer judgment would be new assurance scope.

governance.qualified_creator_host: The current enrolled local creator route is ARM macOS with executable /opt/homebrew/bin/gh. Creator preflight refuses clearly before account access, output/journal creation or network mutation if the trusted CLI is absent/non-executable. No generic executable resolver or Linux/Intel production creator enrollment is introduced. Hosted Linux CI adapter tests use fixtures.

qualified_app_identity.scope: Exactly this repository; actual read-only token identity verified and token revoked; workflow qualification remains distinct from activation.
